string.text: Um, hello.
Huh?
Uh, hey.
Hey, stalker!
You look too young to be a stalker. What are you, seventeen?
Maybe I am. Or maybe I just have a youthful face.
Hmm, perhaps. Surely the "Duty" won't recruit teenagers, right?
That’s right, they won't. So, that's settled.
What are you doing out here, so far from the checkpoint?
Oh, just taking a stroll.
Just taking a stroll, huh? Right, sure...
Why not take a stroll? I happen to like this kind of weather, that’s all.
Stalker, don't shoot! I know for sure you're here, I've tracked your PDA!
What are you doing here?
I’m following you.
What for? On someone’s orders?
No, I decided this on my own. Look, take me with you.
Why on earth would I do that?

It’s just that... after you left, our camp was attacked by the Killers clan. We fought them off, but we took heavy losses. The wounded have been moved out, so our outpost is completely empty now. So, will you take me along?
Well, why don’t you go help your comrades-in-arms instead of dragging yourself here? Or better yet, just go back home. What are you even doing in the Zone?
I was born here. Well, before the anomalies, of course—but this is my home. I used to live in Zalessk, right where the Bar is now.
Then go back to the Bar and stay there until you’ve got some sense in your head.
Come on, please. I’ve seen what you’re like — you’re a tough guy; you take down everyone who gets in your way without even breaking a sweat.
Get moving, didn't you hear me?! "Duty’s" presence isn’t limited to just one checkpoint in the Garbage — they’ll find some more work for you. That’s it, end of discussion.
Messer, I'm here! Come over, let's talk.
Damn it all. No weapons, no documents… I need to find my stuff, and fast!
For once, I’m actually glad to see you. What are you all doing here?

I saw the Killers grab you as you left the lab, so I followed them. Boar was against us coming to get you, but the rest of the guys voted for it, so here we are. A lot of people have high hopes for you.
High hopes? But why?
Legend has it that the thrice-born will change our world for the better. We believe that’s you.
Not this nonsense again. Aren’t you all tired of it yet? I’m barely a twice-born as it stands and even that is a huge stretch!
You think we’re wrong about you?
I think you’re engaging in idol worship. I’m hardly a good role model, and an even worse idol to worship.
That’s a mistake, Messer. A big mistake. Even if you don’t believe in your own destiny, doesn’t the world deserve to be saved?
Let the messiahs save the world. I’m just some random guy with a dirty face who can’t even remember his own name.
But you’re already changing the Zone for the better! Thanks to your actions, the clan of Killers might well have been wiped out today!
And the Zone can thank the "Duty" for that. Great work, fighters.

Well, we aren’t exactly the "Duty" — we're just a small part of the faction. Most of our guys are old-timers who arrived in the Zone years ago and ended up staying. They never would have banded together without you.
And what about your command?

The commanders live in a completely different reality. They have their own goals—things we know nothing about. Something to do with protecting the world from the Zone. I’ve never even seen that world we're supposedly trying to protect, and the others have long since forgotten everything about it. \n\nSometimes, the command receives instructions from that very world. I tried to eavesdrop once, but I couldn’t make heads or tails of it. Just a jumble of noise and random numbers.
Morse code, I reckon… Well, be proud of yourselves. The rank-and-file fighters are the real meat of the faction, rather than a couple of guys at the top.
Maybe you’re right. But still…
What, still trying to talk me into letting you join up as my partner?
And would you agree?
Just this once, and only as far as the Bar. After that, our paths part ways again. Right, let’s go; we’re short on time.
Thanks for letting me tag along, Messer! I’ll scout the path ahead and wait for you at the Garbage.
Hey! Why are you standing there like you’ve taken root?

Hold on, don’t move—that’s a "Comet"! As long as you stay perfectly still, it won’t touch you. Just pray there isn’t a sudden gust of wind. I’ve seen what it does to people… I imagine that’s how a chicken leg feels inside an oven.
Quiet… it seems to have picked up on our chatter.
I have a feeling it was waiting for us.
Nonsense! It’s just an anomaly; it can’t… think. See? It’s calmed down. Looks like it’s just orbiting that tree.
And what about the "empties"?
What about them? Can they orbit? Sure, probably. I mean, why wouldn’t they?
No, not the artifacts. I meant the "Marked Ones." They don’t seem to have thoughts of their own, yet some of them are specifically hunting you.

That just means someone’s giving them orders. Alright, enough yapping. At this rate, we won’t reach the Bar until tomorrow morning. We’re awaited there, and they’re probably getting impatient. Damn, it’s a shame those documents I grabbed from the lab got lost.
Let’s just say they didn’t get lost.
Maybe they didn’t get lost, but they certainly slipped out of my hands.

Well, here, let me give them back to you. Try to hold onto them a bit tighter this time. 

When all that chaos broke out, I happened to wander into a room that looked like an archive, while I was searching for a way out. I just grabbed everything that would fit in my pack: mostly papers. 

Our General forbids trading in information like this; we’re supposed to hand over everything we find so it can be destroyed. But most of our guys prefer to keep these papers for themselves. Why burn them when you could sell them and have some cash to spare for food, and…

Not bad, not bad at all. You might actually amount to something one day. In ten years or so, maybe. \n\nAnyway, enough chatter. Once we get to the Bar, we’ll take a look at what you've managed to snag. Right, let’s move out.
We’ll need to swing by the checkpoint on the way. I’ve got a stash of food hidden there. We’ll celebrate you getting out of captivity in one piece.
Then let’s pick up the pace!
What the… What happened here? Stay there for a moment; I’m just going to quickly check my stash.
Okay.
In the meantime, might as well take a look at the documents the kid swiped from the base.
Oh, my little stash is still intact! That’s great...
Hey, what the hell is wrong with you, kid?!
